description: Membership in a deductively closed propositional theory is invariant under semantic equivalence of formulas.

  (hT : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.BooleanAlgebrasOfFormulas.IsClosed T)
  {A B : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropFormula α}
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.SemEquivalent A B) : A ∈ T ↔ B ∈ T
